_about.title: Counter matrix for the 8 mains, patch 7.41, Ancient-Divine
_about.method: Matchups from the OpenDota SQL explorer (public_matches, avg_rank_tier 60-79 = Ancient+Divine, match_id > 9083505270 = 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16, 1,184,998 matches). For main H vs opponent X: games = matches with X on the enemy team, wins = H's wins. advantage_pp = shrink(wins, games, prior=60, baseline=H's overall winrate) - H's overall winrate (same as app/R/scoring.R matchup_advantages). specific_pp = advantage_pp + (X's overall winrate - 50): removes the part that is just 'X is a strong hero this patch'. Entries are picked from the top of the specific_pp ranking (games >= 500; a few hand-picked exceptions are noted in the doc) and ordered by tier. ci95_pp = 1.96 * binomial standard error of the raw winrate. local_snapshot = the same numbers from data/raw/opendota/heroes/<id>/matchups.json (/heroes/{id}/matchups, small high-MMR sample; correlation with the explorer is ~0, shown only for comparison). Counter items: mechanic from data/raw/opendota/constants/items.json plus 'pro lift' = how much more often enemies of the main finish with the item than an average player, from the explorer player_matches table (pro/league games since 2026-03-24, final inventories).

evidence.mechanic: ability/item text only (abilities.json/items.json or general knowledge)

_about.tiers: S = hard counter (about -5 pp or worse, solid sample, clear mechanic); A = strong (-4 to -5); B = noticeable (-3 to -4); C = mild/mechanic only.
caveats: Explorer data is not filtered by position: TA, SF and Morphling are often mid in pubs.
One week of data, one patch. Re-run the explorer query after a patch.
Reasons marked (verify) are general knowledge, not checked in an official source.

counters.name: Meepo
counters.reason: Earthbind net roots AM in place (no Blink out) and 2-5 Meepos jump him before Battle Fury.

counters.name: Axe
counters.reason: Berserker's Call forces AM to hit Axe; each hit charges Counter Helix pure damage; Blink can't escape a taunt.

counters.name: Huskar
counters.reason: Blood Magic: Huskar has no mana, so Mana Break, Persecutor and Mana Void do nothing; he wins every early trade.

counters.name: Ursa
counters.reason: Fury Swipes + Enrage win the 10-20 min fights and early Roshan while AM is still farming.

counters.name: Slardar
counters.reason: Slithereen Crush + Bash of the Deep lock AM before he can Blink; Corrosive Haze cuts armor and gives true sight.

best_victims.name: Medusa
best_victims.reason: Mana Shield turns Medusa's mana into HP: Mana Break + Mana Void delete both at once (+13 pp, the biggest edge in this report).

best_victims.name: Largo
best_victims.reason: Largo is a support with no hard lock on AM; AM farms and ignores him (mechanic not verified for this new hero).

best_victims.name: Storm Spirit
best_victims.reason: Ball Lightning costs mana per distance: Mana Break leaves Storm unable to escape; Counterspell reflects Orchid-type targeted spells.

best_victims.name: Bristleback
best_victims.reason: Bristleback's damage comes from spell spam (Goo, Quill Spray); Mana Break starves him and Counterspell reflects Goo.

best_victims.name: Morphling
best_victims.reason: Morphling pays 10 mana/s to shift and needs mana for Waveform; Mana Break turns off his survival.

mechanical_counters.note: Mana Break/Mana Void scale with the target's mana; vs. Blood Magic they are blank.
Blink is a movement spell: taunt, Duel and roots stop it. LC: -2.7 pp specific / -4.1 raw on 12k games.
AM's power spike is late; heroes that fight at minute 8-15 punish the farm route.

mechanical_counters.mechanic: Mana Void is wasted on heroes with little or no mana
mechanical_counters.note: Mana Void damage = missing mana of the target; no mana pool -> no ultimate.

counter_items.name: Orchid Malevolence
counter_items.why: Silences Blink and Counterspell for 5 s; pros buy it 1.9x more often vs AM.

counter_items.name: Monkey King Bar
counter_items.why: Bought 2x more vs AM in pro games (vs his Butterfly/Manta late game).

counter_items.name: Abyssal Blade
counter_items.why: Stun through BKB, no Blink out.

counter_items.name: Scythe of Vyse
counter_items.why: Hex: AM cannot Blink or Counterspell. Note: Counterspell can reflect it if pre-cast.

counters.name: Anti-Mage
counters.reason: Mana Break burns the mana Morph needs for Attribute Shift (10 mana/s) and Waveform (115).

counters.name: Bane
counters.reason: Fiend's Grip and Nightmare disable Morph; Attribute Shift can't be used while stunned (abilities.json). n=633, wide CI.

counters.name: Ancient Apparition
counters.reason: Ice Blast stops healing: shifting to Strength no longer saves you (general knowledge, verify).

counters.name: Nyx Assassin
counters.reason: Mind Flare burns % of max mana + passive Mana Burn: no mana = no shift, no Waveform. -6.7 pp raw.

counters.name: Axe
counters.reason: Berserker's Call taunts through shift; Counter Helix pure damage ignores the STR-shift magic-res plan.

best_victims.name: Huskar
best_victims.reason: Morph can morph Huskar's spells and out-range him with Agility attack range (Ebb and Flow); n=1013.

best_victims.name: Lifestealer
best_victims.reason: Melee LS can't stick to a ranged hero with Waveform + slow resistance from Strength (Ebb and Flow).

best_victims.name: Brewmaster
best_victims.reason: Brewmaster's split is slow, magic-heavy; Morph shifts STR and survives. n=800, wide CI.

best_victims.name: Jakiro
best_victims.reason: Jakiro is a slow, magic-damage support: shift STR + Waveform onto him.

best_victims.name: Sniper
best_victims.reason: Sniper is fragile with no escape: Waveform (invulnerable) closes the gap.

mechanical_counters.heroes_or_items: Anti-Mage, Nyx Assassin, Diffusal Blade, Bane (Fiend's Grip steals mana)
mechanical_counters.note: Attribute Shift costs 10 mana/s; Waveform 115 mana. No mana -> Morph is a 0-armor agility hero.

mechanical_counters.heroes_or_items: Ancient Apparition (Ice Blast), Doom (Doom blocks healing), Spirit Vessel, Eye of Skadi
mechanical_counters.note: Doom: 'prevents ... healing in any way' (abilities.json). Vessel/Skadi bought 1.5x/1.6x more vs Morph in pro games.
Attribute Shift is not castable while stunned (CASTABLE WHILE STUNNED: 0).
MKB is bought 1.9x more vs Morph in pro games.

counter_items.name: Orchid Malevolence
counter_items.why: Silence = no Waveform/Morph; 1.6x more often vs Morph (pro).

counter_items.name: Spirit Vessel
counter_items.why: -70% health restoration; 1.5x more often vs Morph (pro).

counter_items.name: Eye of Skadi
counter_items.why: -50% health restoration + slow; 1.6x more often vs Morph (pro).

counters.name: Tidehunter

counters.name: Underlord
counters.reason: Firestorm waves + Pit of Malice root wipe illusions in the area; Atrophy Aura cuts their base damage.

counters.name: Dark Seer

counters.name: Axe
counters.reason: Every illusion that attacks Axe charges Counter Helix (pure AoE): PL's army kills itself.

counters.name: Meepo
counters.reason: Poof is AoE from up to 5 bodies; Earthbind roots the army. n=1164.

best_victims.name: Clinkz
best_victims.reason: Clinkz is single-target and can't tell PL from illusions.

best_victims.name: Ogre Magi
best_victims.reason: Ogre Magi's damage is single-target; Diffusal PL drains him.

best_victims.name: Templar Assassin

best_victims.name: Wraith King

best_victims.name: Terrorblade
best_victims.reason: TB's Metamorphosis is single-target damage; Sunder can be wasted on an illusion (general knowledge).
